description:
`msg-to-mailbox` delivers HTTP `msg` notifications to the caller's verified UnitySVC mailbox.

The gateway turns the `msg` into a plain-text email — the `title` as the subject, markdown reduced to text, and links and image URLs listed under the message — and sends it from the platform's svcpass.com domain using the gateway-native `notify://email` primitive. The destination is the platform-managed primary email on the caller's account, so customers cannot self-assert a recipient.

Use the `default` channel at the canonical gateway URL. No enrollment parameter, SMTP server, or email-provider API key is required. This service is not usable until you set a primary email under Settings → Account — until then, delivery fails closed.
name: msg-to-mailbox
summary: POST a `msg` envelope and UnitySVC emails it to your verified primary address — no recipient to choose, no SMTP server or provider API key of your own.
